integrity: The proof is self-contained. Small exact-rational tests are corroborative only; no independent scientific validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Construction is specific to the underlying real geometry of complex c_0 and its real-convex near-unit balls; it neither produces a balanced unit ball nor computes exact Hausdorff distance. No claim of exhaustive publication-priority verification.
title: Modulus-support-free convex bodies arbitrarily close to the complex \(c_0\) unit ball
